title: Master of the Ruins
next_chapter_hook: The Master of the Ruins gazed deeply into the depths of Chen Ji's bloodline, speaking in a melancholic tone: "Your fate was written the moment you were born—and the hand that inscribed it did not come from the mortal realm."

text.content:
As Chen Ji pushed open the dust-laden door, a familiar yet strange wave of remnant soul energy rushed toward him—Mo Xiansheng, exactly how much have you been hiding?

The stone door burst open, and a vast, abyss-like aura swept outward. Chen Ji instinctively took half a step back, narrowing his eyes as he surveyed the scene before him. This was no secret chamber he had imagined, but a boundless void.

Beneath his feet lay transparent jade flooring, with a faintly visible star river flowing underneath. Above his head hung inverted mountains and overturned palaces, as if heaven and earth had completely reversed in this moment. And standing in the very center of this incomprehensible space, a illusory figure stood with hands clasped behind his back, surrounded by countless billions of mysterious runes.

Those runes... Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply.

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's voice resounded from behind, yet carried unprecedented reverence) "Tianji Pavilion Seventeenth Generation Pavilion Keeper Mo Yuan, pays respects to the Pavilion Master's Remnant Spirit."

text.content:
Pavilion Master's Remnant Spirit? Chen Ji's heart jolted. Mo Xiansheng had called himself the "Chessboard Guardian," and called Chen Xuan "Master," but had never mentioned any "Tianji Pavilion." And now he actually performs the ceremony of a Pavilion Keeper before this illusory figure—what does this mean?

The illusory figure slowly turned around. Chen Ji saw a face seven-tenths similar to Mo Xiansheng's, yet appearing far more dignified and authoritative, with a vertical mark between its brows, like the trace of a third eye.

The Master of the Ruins examined Chen Ji, his gaze profound as an abyss, as if scrutinizing an artifact that had waited for countless ages. The silence lasted a full ten breaths before he finally spoke, his voice like a great bell echoing through the void:

dialogue.content:
"Mo Yuan, you are indeed loyal, having guarded this fragment for three thousand years." The Master of the Ruins' voice carried no emotion, yet caused Chen Ji to feel a bone-deep chill, "But do you know, the Tianji Record never selects an 'inheritor,' but rather—"

He raised his hand, pointing at Chen Ji.

"—a Vessel."

text.content:
Vessel?

These two words poured over Chen Ji like a basin of ice water. His expression remained unchanged, but his heart surged with giant waves. He had learned from Mo Xiansheng that the Tianji Record would backlash, yet he had never imagined he was merely a so-called "vessel."

The Tianji Record chose him, not for his talent, not for his disposition, but to use him as some kind of tool?

The Master of the Ruins seemed to see through his thoughts, calmly saying: "You harbor hatred, yet know how to endure. This is good." He waved his hand, and an image materialized in the void—a starry sky covered in blood, with countless stars extinguishing one by one.

dialogue.content:
"The true purpose of the Tianji Pavilion's creation was never to allow mortals to peer into heavenly secrets." The Master of the Ruins' voice suddenly grew heavy, "But to—oppose it."

In the image, deep within that blood-colored starry sky, a massive eye slowly opened.

That eye had no pupil, only chaotic void, yet it seemed capable of devouring everything. Chen Ji merely gazed at a wisp of its projection, yet felt the Tianji Record Fragment within him tremble intensely, as if in fear, or perhaps in submission.

text.content:
Eye of Heavenly Dao.

These four words flashed through Chen Ji's mind. This was not some specific person, but an existence transcending all conscious entities—the will projection of Heavenly Dao itself.

The Master of the Ruins withdrew the image, the illusory figure dimming somewhat, as the previous display had consumed much of his strength: "In ancient times, it attempted to devour this realm, transforming all living things into its sustenance. The First Pavilion Master of the Tianji Pavilion used himself as bait, sealing its consciousness within the River of Time, yet at a terrible cost—the Tianji Record thereby became its eye."

Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted: "The Tianji Record is... its eye?"

dialogue.content:
"Every time you use the Tianji Record to glimpse the future, you are providing it nourishment." The Master of the Ruins' voice was terrifyingly calm, "You believe you are consuming 'Heavenly Fate Value,' when in truth you are feeding it. For three thousand years, countless prophets have been drained dry just like this."

He paused, his gaze falling upon Chen Ji:

"But you are different. Within your bloodline, the First Pavilion Master left a contingency. This is the true reason the Tianji Record selected you."

text.content:
Bloodline.

Chen Ji unconsciously clenched his fist. His origin had always been a mystery—a servant disciple of humble birth, yet possessing scheming and calculation that even the Inner Sect Senior Fellow envied. His parents had never mentioned any special circumstances, claiming only to be ordinary wandering cultivators.

"Where does my bloodline originate?" he asked, his voice calm without the slightest ripple.

The Master of the Ruins seemed quite satisfied with his composure, the illusory figure slightly nodding: "Before the First Pavilion Master perished, he merged a wisp of his Origin Divine Soul into a bloodline. This bloodline passed through various hands in succession, ultimately arriving in your body."

choice.prompt: The Master of the Ruins revealed shocking truth, and Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.description: Regardless of the Tianji Record's schemes, growing stronger is fundamental. Accept the inheritance fragment and gain partial power from the Fourth Page.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Tianji Record Fourth Page Inheritance Fragment, unlock new skill "Tianji Shield"
choices.risk_hint: The inheritance process may trigger the Tianji Record's backlash mechanism

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, slightly bending his knees, and performed a formal bow to the Master of the Ruins: "The junior is willing to accept the inheritance."

The Master of the Ruins' illusory figure slightly nodded, pressing his hand against Chen Ji's brow center. A scalding force immediately surged into his body, as if countless threads of information were being poured into his Mental Sea in an instant. Chen Ji grunted in pain, yet did not retreat; instead, he actively spread his divine consciousness, welcoming that force.

Agonizing pain swept through his entire body like knife slashes, but a glint of sharpness flashed in his eyes—this was the price of growing stronger, and he could bear it.

choices.description: Why did the First Pavilion Master of the Tianji Pavilion perish? How did his Origin Divine Soul merge into a bloodline? Chen Ji wanted to know clearly.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke the remnant spirit of the Master of the Ruins
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more complete intelligence, providing key information for subsequent strategic planning
choices.risk_hint: The Master of the Ruins may be unwilling to reveal more, or the revealed truth could be even more shocking

text.content:
"Wait." Chen Ji raised his hand to stop the Master of the Ruins, "The junior has one thing unclear—since the First Pavilion Master had already perished, how could his Origin Divine Soul merge into bloodline inheritance? If not through personal experience, how could this be accomplished?"

The Master of the Ruins paused mid-action, a strange glint flickering in his eyes: "You are indeed perceptive."

He fell silent for a moment, as if making some decision. Finally, he slowly spoke: "Because... the First Pavilion Master did not truly perish."

choices.description: Since the key lies hidden within the bloodline, it would be better to proactively awaken the dormant power, perhaps gaining unexpected rewards.
choices.visible_reward: If successful, one will obtain primordial power stronger than the inheritance fragment
choices.risk_hint: Bloodline awakening carries extreme risk; failure may damage one's foundation

text.content:
Chen Ji didn't wait for the inheritance from the Ruins Master. Instead, he bit his fingertip sharply, dripping a drop of refined blood onto the transparent ground.

"What are you doing!" Mo Xiansheng cried out in alarm.

But Chen Ji didn't answer. His divine sense plunged into his body, following the faint pull within the bloodline, probing into its deepest depths. Something there was sleeping, waiting to be awakened.

In an instant, a golden radiance erupted from his chest, illuminating the entire void!

Within the golden light, Chen Ji felt his blood boiling as if. Some ancient power was awakening, spreading through his meridians to every extremity of his body. That power was entirely different from the Tianji Record's aura—the Tianji Record was cold, scrutinizing, with a certain high-and-mighty审视; but this power was warm, all-encompassing, as if a call from the depths of his bloodline.

The Ruins Master's phantom trembled violently at this moment, runes surging like a tide: "This is...the Primordial Divine Soul responding to you!"

Chen Ji felt his consciousness pulled into a strange space.

There was no distinction of up or down, left or right—only endless starlight surrounding him. And at the very center of that starry expanse, a figure resembling yet distinct from the Ruins Master stood with hands clasped behind his back. He wore plain cyan robes, his features ordinary, yet his aura was as unfathomable as an abyss.

"You've finally arrived." The figure spoke, his voice so gentle it seemed unrelated to life-or-death matters, "I have waited three thousand years."

Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly: "Are you...the First Sect Master?"

dialogue.content:
"Just a wisp of his remnant will left behind." The First Sect Master smiled faintly, "The true him perished alongside that eye. But this wisp of will is enough to sustain you until you make your choice."

He raised his hand, and the image of that blood-red eye manifested once more in the void: "Three thousand years ago, I suppressed its consciousness but could not utterly destroy it. It is slowly awakening, and the Tianji Record within you is the key to its reawakening."

"In other words—" Chen Ji interjected, his voice calm, "I am the key for it to return to this realm?"

text.content:
The First Sect Master fell silent for a moment, then shook his head: "No. You are the only one who can stop it."

He stepped forward, pressing a finger to Chen Ji's brow center. A warm current immediately surged in, and Chen Ji felt an acupoint within him that had been sealed suddenly burst open, an unprecedented clarity flooding his Mental Sea.

"I integrated a wisp of my Primordial Divine Soul into the bloodline precisely to wait for this day." The First Sect Master's voice became solemn, "Though the Tianji Record Fragment within you is incomplete, combined with my Primordial Essence, it can temporarily shield it from perception."

dialogue.content:
"Shield from perception?" Chen Ji caught the key point, "Do you mean the Tianji Record has been transmitting information to it this whole time?"

"Every prophecy is a summoning." The First Sect Master's voice grew heavy, "It senses this realm through the Tianji Record,汲取养分. And the more you use prophecy, the faster it awakens."

Chen Ji's heart shuddered. No wonder he felt inexplicable exhaustion every time he used the Tianji Record—that was not the backlash of Heavenly Fate, but that eye devouring his life!

text.content:
"But now it's different." The First Sect Master's voice rang out, and Chen Ji felt his bloodline resonating with some ancient power, "I have opened the first seal for you. From now on, when you use the Tianji Record, the bloodline power will automatically form a barrier, weakening its erosion of you."

He paused, adding: "But this comes at a cost. Every time you use the Tianji Record, the connection between you and that eye deepens. When the connection reaches a certain critical point—"

He didn't finish, but Chen Ji already understood.

Either he completely seals that eye, or he becomes its puppet.

No third path.

Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then suddenly laughed. That laughter echoed in the empty starry expanse, carrying an indescribable meaning.

"Interesting." He murmured, his eyes holding no fear, only a nearly manic calm, "I thought this was merely a simple story of a废物 reversing their fate, never expecting to be drawn into this level of chess game from the very beginning."

He raised his head, staring directly at the First Sect Master's phantom: "Since that's the case, I'll overturn this entire game of chess."

choice.prompt: Facing such shocking truth, how will Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Since we must make an enemy of the Heavenly Secrets Eye, we need a foolproof strategy. The First Sect Master has been setting up for three thousand years—there must be contingencies.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the First Sect Master's complete layout plan, learn more key information about sealing the Heavenly Secrets Eye
choices.risk_hint: Too much information may cause cognitive load, affecting subsequent judgments

text.content:
"Three thousand years." Chen Ji said deeply, "You've been setting up for three thousand years—surely you didn't leave only this move. Since you chose me, you must have a complete plan. Tell me, what do I need to do?"

The First Sect Master's phantom nodded slightly, a flash of approval flickering in his eyes: "Good. First, the fourth page of the Tianji Record must be gathered. Second, you need to find the 'Heavenly Fate Lock-Key'—that thing which can interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight."

Heavenly Fate Lock-Key. Chen Ji's heart一震. He thought of his sister who had been missing for years—Chen Nian.

choices.description: The First Sect Master has been setting up for three thousand years, choosing him as a 'vessel'—could there be other purposes? Chen Ji needs confirmation.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke the remnant will's anger
choices.visible_reward: Reveal the First Sect Master's true purpose in his three-thousand-year layout, and the deeper relationship between him and the Heavenly Secrets Eye
choices.risk_hint: The First Sect Master's remnant will may be unwilling to reveal certain key information

text.content:
"Wait." Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his gaze sharp, "You said my bloodline is the vessel for your Primordial Divine Soul. So when the Tianji Record chose me—was it because of my bloodline, or because you had already implanted your divine soul into me long ago?"

The First Sect Master's phantom paused.

"In other words—" Chen Ji's voice turned cold, "Am I myself, or am I your tool for resurrection?"

The void fell into dead silence. After a long while, the First Sect Master slowly spoke, his voice carrying a complex undertone: "You truly...are more like him than I expected."

The first generation Pavilion Master fell silent for a long while before finally letting out a long sigh: 'You ask well. Three thousand years ago, I too asked myself the same question.'

His phantom grew dimmer, as if enduring some tremendous consumption: 'When I fused my primordial divine soul into the bloodline, my intention was to leave a contingency. But I never expected that this wisp of soul would continuously grow over three thousand years, eventually giving birth to an independent consciousness.'

Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly: 'You mean... there are two consciousnesses in my bloodline?'

dialogue.content:
'Not two consciousnesses.' The first generation Pavilion Master shook his head. 'It is your consciousness and my remnant will, competing for dominance over the same body.'

His voice grew heavy: 'From the moment you were born, you could perceive the aura of the Tianji Record, effortlessly making arrangements and strategies that ordinary people could not—that is not talent, but the influence of my remnant will. How much of what you thought was your own wisdom is truly yours, and how much is mine?'

Chen Ji stood frozen.

He had always believed he relied on wisdom and patience to reach where he was today, yet he never imagined everything might be a script arranged by someone else.

text.content:
'But there is one thing I must tell you.' The first generation Pavilion Master's voice suddenly became solemn. 'Although my remnant will influenced your growth, it cannot control your choices. Every decision you made was based on your own will—even if that will was influenced by me.'

He raised his hand, and a scene appeared in the void—a newborn baby's birth, the infant's eyes holding an innate depth.

'This is the moment of your birth.' The first generation Pavilion Master said. 'I could influence you, but I could not create you. The bloodline in you is what I left behind, but to what extent you can utilize this bloodline depends entirely on your own destiny.'

Chen Ji fell silent for a long time.

He thought of his various strategies over the years—playing the fool at the Tianqing Sect, his maneuvering around Su Qingyao, his calculations regarding Ye Qing, and those seemingly casual yet meticulously crafted schemes. If all of this was arranged by someone else...

No.

He abruptly raised his head, a flash of enlightenment in his eyes: 'Even though you influenced my growth, every step I took along this path was my own choice. You can influence my way of thinking, but you cannot make decisions for me.'

A slight smile curled at the corner of his mouth, revealing a cold, chilling grin: 'That, is already enough.'

dialogue.content:
The first generation Pavilion Master froze for a moment, then let out a light laugh. That laughter carried relief and also a sense of liberation: 'Good. Good, this is already enough.'

His phantom began to dissipate, yet his voice grew clearer: 'Chen Ji, remember—destiny can be written, but it can also be rewritten. The Tianji Record is its eyes, but your bloodline is the ember I left behind. When the ember grows strong enough, it can burn away all that gazes upon it.'

'Go. Gather the Tianji Record, find the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, awaken the sleeping power within your bloodline.'

'And before that—survive.'

text.content:
As the words fell, the first generation Pavilion Master's phantom completely dissipated. At the same time, Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his brow center, a golden talisman slowly manifesting then vanishing, and a massive stream of information flooded into his Mental Sea.

That was the inheritance fragment of the fourth page of the Tianji Record—though incomplete, it was enough to temporarily shield the Tianji Record's feedback to the Heavenly Eye.

At the same time, deep within his bloodline, a door long sealed was violently pushed open. An unprecedented power flowed through his body—that was the product of the fusion between the first generation Pavilion Master's primordial divine soul and his own bloodline—

'Tianji Veil.'

From now on, every time he uses the Tianji Record, he will no longer be prey to that eye, but a hunter who truly holds the initiative.

When Chen Ji opened his eyes again, he found himself still standing in that void. The ruins master's phantom had already dissipated, leaving only a faint voice echoing in his ears:

'The fourth page fragment of the Tianji Record has merged into your bloodline. But to obtain the complete fourth page, you need to find two more fragments—one in the Xuanwu Sect's Forbidden Grounds, one deep within the Demonic Path Holy Sect.'

'As for the Heavenly Fate Lock Key...' The voice suddenly paused, as if hesitating whether to continue. In the end, it merely sighed faintly:

'Go to the Holy Sect. Your answer lies there.'

The void began to collapse, and Chen Ji felt a powerful repulsive force pushing him outward. At the last moment before he was about to leave, he suddenly spoke, his voice calm yet firm:

dialogue.content:
'No matter how destiny writes me, I will rewrite it with my own hands.'

He paused, the corner of his mouth slightly lifting, revealing a meaningful smile: 'After all—I am someone who holds grudges.'

With those words, Chen Ji was expelled from the void, appearing at the entrance of that dust-covered great hall. Mo Xiansheng's figure had long since vanished, leaving only an ancient jade slip lying quietly on the ground—the final inheritance left for him.

And deep within Chen Ji's Mental Sea, that page of the Tianji Record fragment that had been silent suddenly flickered with a faint glow, as if responding to the power just awakened in his bloodline.

The fourth page's inheritance fragment had been branded into the depths of his soul.

text.content:
The ruins master gazed one final time into the depths of Chen Ji's bloodline, sighing: 'Your destiny was written the moment you were born—and the hand that wrote it did not come from the mortal realm.'

At that moment, Chen Ji suddenly understood.

From the beginning, he was never just an ordinary废物 disciple. His birth, his bloodline, his encounter with the Tianji Record—everything was arranged at some higher level.

But so what?

The smile at the corner of his lips grew colder, yet his eyes burned with unprecedented light.

Even as heaven's destined piece, he would overturn this chess game.

Even as written destiny, he would rewrite it with his own hands.
